mapper.select: SELECT id, name, points, gift_points, original_amount, actual_amount, currency, status, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM points_recharge_product WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id, name, points, gift_points, original_amount, actual_amount, currency, status, sort, created_at, updated_at FROM points_recharge_product WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, product_id, points, gift_points, original_amount, actual_amount, currency, payment_channel, status, transaction_id, points_transaction_no, pay_time, callback_time, created_at, updated_at FROM points_recharge_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_no, user_id, product_id, points, gift_points, original_amount, actual_amount, currency, payment_channel, status, transaction_id, points_transaction_no, pay_time, callback_time, created_at, updated_at FROM points_recharge_order WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, order_id, provider, transaction_id, payment_intent_id, amount, currency, status, raw_response, created_at FROM points_recharge_payment WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_id, provider, transaction_id, payment_intent_id, amount, currency, status, raw_response, created_at FROM points_recharge_payment WHERE provider = #{provider} AND payment_intent_id = #{paymentIntentId} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: pro.id, pro.order_no, pro.user_id, su.username, pro.product_id, product.name AS product_name, pro.points, pro.gift_points, pro.original_amount, pro.actual_amount, pro.currency, pro.payment_channel, pro.status, prp.payment_intent_id, pro.transaction_id, pro.points_transaction_no, pro.pay_time, pro.created_at

FROM points_recharge_order pro LEFT JOIN points_recharge_product product ON product.id = pro.product_id LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = pro.user_id LEFT JOIN points_recharge_payment prp ON prp.id = ( SELECT p2.id FROM points_recharge_payment p2 WHERE p2.order_id = pro.id ORDER BY p2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_id, product_id, gift_points, status, created_at, updated_at FROM member_points_gift_rule WHERE status = 1 AND plan_id = #{planId} AND (product_id = #{productId} OR product_id = 0) ORDER BY CASE WHEN product_id = #{productId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id DESC LIMIT 1
